title: Who Is Martin Mull?
plot_overview: This portrait traces a performer’s restless reinvention, moving from smoky folk clubs to primetime sitcoms and gallery walls. He tells his story in his own words, joined by reflections from friends who watched his varied career unfold.
will_you_like_this: You’ll like this if you enjoy personal accounts of performers with varied creative careers; Not for you if you prefer fictional stories or a plot-driven experience.
review_summary: Pros: broad career portrait; personal reflections; varied creative life | Cons: no critical viewpoints; limited detail; no viewer reactions
